provenance.method: Isolated logged-out MoooKakaoProbe copy of the official binary, spawned under Frida. For each case: NTChatLeverage alloc/init, setAuthorId (the logged-out own user ID 0 when authored_by_self, else a synthetic ID), setMessage (skipped when message is null), setAttachment (skipped when attachment is null), setStatus 1; then -lastMessage: NO (summary) and YES (export_summary, the reply src_message source), -subtype, -availableForReply/-availableForReaction (the NTChatMessage base predicates, which need a chat room, were replaced with YES so only the type-71 override decides), and from +[KAOLeverageMessageData leverageDataWithUserMessage:] -subtypeString, -availablePulicLinkUrlString (the tap link), -isMobileOnlyMessage, -lockable, -adultOnly, and +[KAOLeverageMessageCellView subTypeViewClassWithMessage:leverageMessageData:] (bubble_view). A case that killed the process is recorded as crashed and the run restarted after it. +[NTChatMessage classWithType:message:chatId:] returned NTChatLeverage for both 71 and 73. Original preferences were hash-checked unchanged.

notes: Inputs are synthetic. Unless mooo_expected says otherwise, mooo bridges summary as the message body, appends public_link (the tap link) on its own line, and allows a Matrix reply exactly when reply_available is true and a Matrix reaction exactly when reaction_available is true. No chat room is attached, so the growable rule (BC, Plus chats only) never applied. The logged-out harness has no adult verification, so reply_available is false for ADULT cards; a verified account would see Reply.
